note: The key is a secret prefix prepended to the message before hashing. STATUS is permitted from this replica; DISPATCH is privileged and not authorised here.

wire.message_hex: lowercase hex of the raw command bytes

parser.algorithm: split the command bytes on '&'; split each token on the first '='; keep tokens whose key matches ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$; last value wins

commands.DISPATCH: privileged; releases the authorization code when accepted
